description: This file defines a FastAPI application with two data models (Item and User) and an API endpoint for updating an item with associated user data, utilizing request body parameters.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Pydantic model representing an item with optional description and tax, and required name and price.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a user with optional full name and required username.

methods.name: update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body())
methods.description: Asynchronous API endpoint function that handles PUT requests to update an item, accepting path parameter, two models, and a body parameter 'importance'.

ctags.name: update_item
ctags.pattern: /^async def update_item(item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body()):$/
ctags.signature: (item_id: int, item: Item, user: User, importance: int = Body())
